newsitem.title: USA: Stone Energy sets 1997 budget of $104 mln.
newsitem.headline: Stone Energy sets 1997 budget of $104 mln.

text.p: Stone Energy Corp said Wednesday its 1997 development budget has been set at $104 million.
The company said development projects include drilling and completing 23 new wells, 26 workovers and re-completions of existing wells, and constructing and installing three new platforms.
Stone Energy said it would continue to pursue investments in new properties. Capital expenditures for 1996 were $78 million.
During 1996, the company produced 1.4 million barrels of oil and 11.3 billion cubic feet of natural gas, or a total of 3.2 million equivalent barrels of oil, an increase of 16 percent from 1995.
The reserve increases resulted primarily from the development of South Pelto Block 23 and acquisitions of interests in Lake Hermitage, Vermilion Block 46 and Vermilion Block 131.
